articles.description: MLB’s offseason is officially underway, and one of the Orioles’ first decisions was to part ways with one of their longest-tenured players.
articles.title: Orioles decline Ryan Mountcastle’s $7.5M team option, making him free agent

articles.description: Orioles closer Ryan Helsley is returning for another season after he picked up his 2027 player option, a source confirmed to The Sun.
articles.title: Orioles’ Ryan Helsley picks up $14M player option to return for 2027 season

articles.description: New GM Jared Banner has sought advice from former Orioles players in the first week including a pair of Hall of Famers.
articles.title: Orioles GM Jared Banner gets early input from Jim Palmer, Cal Ripken Jr.

articles.description: The Luis Robert Jr. era in Baltimore was short-lived. The Orioles have declined the oft-injured outfielder’s $20 million team option for 2027, the club announced Saturday amid a series of roster moves ...
articles.title: Orioles decline $20M team option for Luis Robert Jr. amid flurry of moves
